macros.name: entry
macros.doc: You create entries in your rubrics by calling the \entry macro.

macros.name: headerspace
macros.doc: \headerspace is the amount of extra vertical space to put after the headers.

macros.name: input
macros.doc: In order to implement the flavor mechanism, the LaTeX macro \input has been redefined to look for “flavored” files first.

macros.name: keyalignment
macros.doc: entries’keys horizontal alignment can be changed thanks to the \keyalignment macro.

macros.name: keyfont
macros.doc: The \keyfont macro takes one mandatory argument which redefines the font to use for the entries’ keys.

macros.name: leftheader
macros.doc: The \leftheader and \rightheader macros define respectively the contents of the upper left and upper right headers.

macros.name: makeheaders
macros.doc: If you have defined headers, make them appear by calling \makeheaders just after the beginning of your document.

macros.name: maketitle
macros.doc: If you have defined a title (and possibly a subtitle), make it (them) appear by calling \maketitle after the beginning of your document, and just after \makeheaders if you happen use it.

macros.name: photosep
macros.doc: The \photosep macro is a LaTeX length that specifies the space to leave between the side of the photo and the next headers’s text.

macros.name: prefix
macros.doc: The \prefix macro takes one mandatory argument which redefines the prefix to use.

macros.name: rightheader
macros.doc: The \leftheader and \rightheader macros define respectively the contents of the upper left and upper right headers.

macros.name: rubricafterspace
macros.doc: CurVe provides a new LaTeX length, \rubricafterspace controlling the amount of extra vertical space to put after a rubric (hence, before the next one).

macros.name: rubricfont
macros.doc: The \rubricfont macro takes one mandatory argument which redefines the font to use for rubric titles.

macros.name: rubricspace
macros.doc: \rubricspace is the amount of extra vertical space to put after the rubric title.

macros.name: subrubricspace
macros.doc: \subrubricspace controls the amount of extra vertical space to put after subrubrics.

macros.name: subtitle
macros.doc: The \title and \subtitle macros take one mandatory argument which define respectively your CV’s title and subtitle.

macros.name: subtitlefont
macros.doc: The \titlefont and \subtitlefont macros take one mandatory argument which redefine the fonts to use for the title and the subtitle.

macros.name: text
macros.doc: This macro wraps around \multicol to let people input plain text within a rubric.

macros.name: titlealignment
macros.doc: To specify your preferred title alignment, call \titlealignment with an argument of either l, c or r, the meaning of which should be obvious.

macros.name: titlefont
macros.doc: The \titlefont and \subtitlefont macros take one mandatory argument which redefine the fonts to use for the title and the subtitle.

macros.name: titlespace
macros.doc: \titlespace is the amount of extra vertical space to put after the title(s).
